attributes.gameplay_defects_fixed: FOUR of the eighteen are live gameplay behaviour, not cosmetics. (1) The hidden character's health cap: retail computes 100.0*(level-1)+500.0 and we computed 0.5*(level-1)+30.0, i.e. 79 HP instead of the 9999 clamp at the level-99 loadout, in FIVE places (restore_inactive_player, load_player, PlayersRestoreHealth, PlayerRestoreState, player_get_from_save). (2) The same hidden character's four attributes: retail 999.0f (the function's own cap constant, visible at line `ATT_FIGHT(p) = (cap + stats[2] < 999.0) ? ... : 999.0`), ours 0.9f - a 1110x scale error, and the same block appears twice. (3) clear_player gave a fresh player 100.0f health where retail gives 500.0f - corroborated arithmetically by the hidden-character formula, which also yields exactly 500 at level 1. (4) PlayerAddPowerup's free-slot sentinels: retail marks slots with -1.0f/-2.0f and tests `best == -2.0`, we used 999999.0f/1000000.0f and tested `best == 2000000.0` - a value the initialiser could never take, so OUR loop's first-iteration branch is dead where retail's is live. (5) set_hidden_player passed strength 1.0f to PlayerAddPowerup where retail passes -1.0f; with (4) fixed, a POSITIVE strength routes the cheat powerup down the timed branch while retail's negative strength writes the permanent sentinel - the two defects were interlocking, and the run-42 reloc lane's independent datum census found the same sign. start_magic's throw impulse sign (-1.5 -> 1.5) and do_weakening's heartbeat thresholds (200/25 not 150/50) are two more behaviour changes.

attributes.pin_note: player.c carries 6 webfrank pins (do_exit, ExpToLevel, load_player_geo, do_heal_players, load_player_model, load_player_model_sub). The do_exit literal fix renumbered the anonymous pool and the build aborted with `instruction permutation relocation input hash changed` exactly as AGENTS.md trap 15b predicts. `python tools/gdl/probe.py game/game/player do_exit --rederive-pin` repaired it in one command and reported BODY HASHES ALL UNCHANGED - the audit that makes the paste sound. The other five pins replayed untouched. This is the load_player_geo precedent reproducing: a value-only edit does not disturb a REGISTER_ONLY pin's body.
